root_cause: HermesWsClient is a Kotlin `object` (process-singleton). Its `private val requestId = AtomicInteger(0)` at HermesWsClient.kt:102 persists across the 3 androidTest classes in the same instrumentation JVM. The scripted reply envelopes hardcode id="1"/"2"/"3" under the assumption that each test starts a fresh process — they don't. After test 1 sends session.list / commands.catalog / session.create with id=1,2,3, test 2's first send has id=4, etc. ChatViewModel.handleRpcResult (ChatViewModel.kt:750) does `pendingRequests.remove(id) ?: return`, so the unmatched id silently drops the SESSION_LIST branch and the rail renders empty. waitUntilAtLeastOneExists(rail_item_*) then times out at 30s. Secondary leak: hermes_rail.xml SharedPreferences (last_session/pinned/home_order) persists across tests; stale last_session reroutes handleGatewayReady into switchSession(staleId), firing an unscripted session.resume before any scripted envelope can match.
fix_summary: HermesWsClient.kt: added @VisibleForTesting internal fun resetRequestCounterForTest(rejectInflight: Boolean = true) that calls rejectAllPending() then sets requestId.set(0).

E2eHarness.kt: added fun resetStateForTest() that calls HermesWsClient.resetRequestCounterForTest, clears HermesWsClient.e2eWsOverride, and wipes the hermes_rail SharedPreferences (last_session/pinned/home_order).

RailReorderE2eTest.kt / RenameE2eTest.kt / RenameFailureE2eTest.kt: each test now calls E2eHarness.resetStateForTest() as step 1, and the setup is reordered to the user-requested order: reset → gatewayServer.start()+gw.enqueue → seedServerProfile → e2eWsOverride=wsUrl → ActivityScenario.launch(MainActivity).

contract_match_after_fix: With requestId reset to 0 before each test: id="1" = session.list (sent by handleGatewayReady→loadSessions), id="2" = commands.catalog (handleGatewayReady→fetchCommandCatalog), id="3" = session.create (handleGatewayReady→createNewSession after last_session reset to null). The 4th id (rename tests) = session.resume (id="4"), title = id="5".
